{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tantrans''' were the inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tantra]] in the eponymous [[Tantra sector/Legends|Tantra sector]]. Due to the ice-age that gripped the planet, and the fact that its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]], they lived in enclosed settlements on top of the glaciers.<ref name="Lords of the Expanse">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
